title: Cookie panel covers half the phone screen on arrival
what_happened: The cookie box takes up the bottom half of the screen and covers the "Nuestro Enfoque" button before I have read anything. At least it's in Spanish and lets me reject everything.
expected: A smaller bar that doesn't hide the main buttons, so I can read first.

title: Spanish home page carousel has English titles
what_happened: On the Spanish page, the carousel items are called "July 2026 Bulletin", "How We're Born" and "Where We're Born", in English. The control labels ("Go to item", "Send feedback", "Chat with Carmen") are English too.
expected: Everything on the Spanish page in Spanish: "Boletín de julio 2026", "Cómo nacimos", and so on.

title: Auto-rotating carousel keeps changing the home page; my taps don't land
what_happened: The story carousel under the hero changes every few seconds ("Bienvenido…", "How We're Born", "Where We're Born"…). Even the list of buttons shifts (Rechazar todo moved from 19 to 18). I tried to close the cookie box five times and each time the page had moved before my tap landed.
expected: A carousel that doesn't move on its own, or stops when I touch the page, so I can close the cookie box and read.
